definitions.B_p: row x is e_x-e_{p(x)} if p(x) in V, else e_x when p(x)=r
definitions.cycle_set: CYC(p)=directed cycles of the functional relation p entirely inside V

leibniz_certificate: Each row of B_p has diagonal entry +1 and at most one off-diagonal entry -1.
A nonzero Leibniz permutation can use off-diagonal entries only on a union of pairwise disjoint directed cycles of p; every other row uses its diagonal +1.
For a selected p-cycle of length ell, the permutation-cycle sign is (-1)^(ell-1) and the ell selected matrix entries contribute (-1)^ell; their product is -1.
For any subset S of the c=|CYC(p)| disjoint functional cycles, the corresponding nonzero term is (-1)^|S|.
Thus det(B_p)=0 for c>0 and det(B_p)=1 for c=0.

rooted_survival_certificate.alternate_triangular_check: Define h(x) as the least positive iterate count with p^h(x)=r. Simultaneously order rows and columns by increasing h. Then B_p is unit lower triangular, so det(B_p)=1. This h is proof-only functional iteration rank, not geometric distance.
rooted_survival_certificate.statement: If c=0, every p-iterate reaches r and coefficient is +1.
